findings.summary: unreadableDegradedStores reads from working tree via sys.readText instead of readDegradedStoreDetailed, bypassing the committed-tree precedence rule documented in the module header; fails closed but inconsistent with the design contract
Duplicate stale JSDoc block on degradedContinuation in runner.ts (lines 458-463) contradicts the current design and could mislead a future reader of security-critical ordering logic
readCommittedGrant uses HEAD:<rel> instead of HEAD:./<rel>, missing the fix already applied in committedGovernanceOwner for the same repo-relative resolution issue
parseStore casts workItems array elements without validating element shape; a torn write with a partial element would produce undefined workId, reducing visible work count
nonNegative in gatekeeperCostLedger.ts uses n > 0 guard but name implies >= 0; cosmetic formatMicroUsd output is misleading for zero-cost entries
runner.ts at 873 lines exceeds 800-line file size guideline
degradedMode.ts at 903 lines exceeds 800-line file size guideline

gatekeeper-live-proof.mjs hardcodes ownerConfirmation: true without consulting a committed secrets-handling gate receipt, bypassing the credential gate that criterion10-live-proof.mjs correctly enforces
safeEcho bidi-strip regex uses character-range literal rather than explicit Unicode escapes, fragile to editor normalisation; functionally correct as committed
readDegradedStore returns null for both absent and corrupt stores, collapsing a distinction the design marks CRITICAL; production path is protected by unreadableDegradedStores check
isolationProblems is a pure function; thread isolation depends entirely on callers providing the complete binding set — no runtime enforcement that the set is complete
repoRelativeGitPath does not refuse fnmatch metacharacters in plan paths; documented as accepted risk since only reachable if attacker can commit
isImplementerName does not block Anthropic model-tier names (sonnet, opus, haiku); expectedDecider mismatch catch is the primary guard so gap is narrow
summariseLedger does not validate scope.month format; empty string would inflate monthly total, but failure direction is over-reporting (safe)
SECRET_SHAPE heuristic does not cover all vendor key formats; structural credentialRef control is the enforced boundary
